## About

Dushyant is a Motion Designer and Video Editor based in India. He specializes in animation, film editing, short-form content creation, and motion graphics for brands, creators, and Web3 companies.

His work has generated 16M+ views on client projects, including viral Instagram series and web3 educational content.

## Services

- Motion Design & Animation (After Effects, Illustrator)
- Film Editing & Post-Production (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve)
- Short-Form Content & Instagram Reels
- Creative Direction for SaaS & Startup Launches
- Web3 / Crypto Educational Video Content

## Notable Work

- **Agyaat Khat** (Film Editing) — 16M views on Instagram. Short film series with Agyaat Aadarsh.
- **Across Protocol US** (Motion Design) — Educational Web3 motion videos for crypto bridging platform. 200K+ views per video.
- **VFX AI** (Creative Direction) — Launch motion graphics for an AI SaaS product for editors.
- **Short-Form Reels** — Creator-focused reels for Instagram influencers and college events.
